page: Amazon Web Services r8id.16xlarge is a memory-optimized server powered by the AWS Nitro hypervisor. It features 64 vCPUs and 32 physical cores with hyperthreading, utilizing an Intel Xeon 6975P-C processor clocked at 3.9 GHz. The system is equipped with 512.0 GB of high-speed 7 GHz DDR5 memory, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per core. For local storage, the instance includes 3800 GB of NVMe SSD instance store volumes. Network connectivity is supported by a 30 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

In benchmark evaluations, the r8id.16xlarge demonstrates strong multi-core performance, placing in the top 25% for stress-ng multi-core tests and the top 10% for Geekbench multi-core scores. Its memory subsystem shows strong read-only bandwidth, reaching 5121.18 GB/sec for small cached blocks and 191.69 GB/sec for large uncached blocks, though large block write bandwidth sits in the average tier at 78.73 GB/sec. The processor's advanced instruction sets, including AVX-512 and Intel AMX (Advanced Matrix Extensions), contribute to top-tier performance in image processing, software compilation, and prompt processing for small language models.

Given its high memory-to-vCPU ratio, fast DDR5 memory, and integrated high-capacity NVMe storage, this instance offers high resource density for memory-bound and storage-intensive workloads. It is highly suitable for large-scale databases, in-memory caching systems like Redis, data-intensive web serving, and software compilation pipelines. The inclusion of local NVMe SSDs eliminates the need for separate network-attached storage for high-throughput scratch space, optimizing the overall hardware profile efficiency.
